reason: Two founders, no customers, and they want to put themselves between my customers and my phone. I don't let a stranger answer for my business unless a colleague I know has used it and tells me it works.
objection: If something goes wrong with the forwarding, my customers can't reach me and I don't even notice. And a robot texting my customers in my name is not how I talk to people. I don't trust a new company with my number.
would_change_my_mind: A fellow trade business owner I know telling me they've used it for a few months without problems.
